                                             I. INTRODUCTION

           The Shanklin Trusts respectfully submit this Reply Brief in further support of The Public

Utility Commission of Texas (“PUC”) recommended Route 487, the route best supported by the

record and in adherence of PURA and the Commission’s routing criteria. The hearing proved that

Route 487 best balances compatible corridor utilization, moderation of landowner impacts,

environmental integrity, engineering feasibility, and cost by preserving Route 894’s favorable

attributes while materially improving its forty (40) miles through San Saba and McCulloch

Counties, Texas via compatible corridor utilization and reduced fragmentation, minimizing

avoidable impacts to ranch infrastructure and water resources, while maintaining engineering

feasibility and lowering cost by $16.1 million. 3
